entry.note: Two ordinary courtyard photos show the same independent low log outbuilding with steep weathered board gable roof, horizontal timber gable, small triangular vent and braced low door immediately beside the kitchen. The aerial roof northeast of the kitchen supplies approximate center[37.526115,54.076448] and southwest-facing gable axis. Assignment as the icehouse rather than woodshed remains an explicit estate-context inference: the photographs are grouped under kitchen and do not label this outbuilding individually. This is an original specific exterior interpretation, not a generic icehouse preset. Standard PMTiles/current OSM omit its footprint; own or replace no native building.
